_README: Desensitized routing-gate regression set. Derived from 273 real prod turns across 34 agents (2026-07-29) by keeping ONLY the BM25 score shapes - no queries, narrative names, summaries or ids. expect_short_circuit encodes the INTENDED decision for each shape, not merely today's output: see `note` for why. Tuning FLOOR/MARGIN must keep these green.

cases.note: Sibling narratives within one topic family score within ~35% of each other. BM25 cannot tell them apart; the LLM tier must pick. Real shapes: two 'holdings scan' narratives, two 'MathFRAYT bug' narratives, two 'ESG analysis' narratives.

Short follow-up turns ('draw me a chart', 'give me a download link') produce low raw BM25 no matter how right the match is - measured median top1 raw is 5.3 for queries under 40 chars vs 12-15 above. A high absolute floor would reject these wrongly, so the floor stays a noise filter and the MARGIN decides.
